verdict.rationale: LocalAI doesn't ship its own branded SDK, but its OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages API-compatible endpoints let developers use existing official OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs against it (localai-docs-1, localai-docs-2, localai-docs-16, localai-docs-32). This satisfies 'building against an SDK' only indirectly via compatibility layers rather than a first-party client library, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (localai-probe-3) which would help SDK-based integration. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party LocalAI SDK/client library, published OpenAPI schema, and independent developer corroboration of SDK compatibility in practice.
